QUOTE: **Per-thread log routing.** Every bridge thread installs a `HandleLogScope` with the owning handle's `log_id`, so log lines go to the right session even on background threads.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that threads install a per-handle logging scope so background logs route to the owning handle. It says "every bridge thread" and doesn't say "first statement", but the mechanism and its purpose are both named.
